notes: [mpf] Member comparison uses the 'Our Coalition' page (planning team + leader team organizations by category, ~110 names). Matched loosely: 'Pilgrim Coalition' = 'Pilgrim Legislative Advisory Coalition' (assumed same, so not in new/not_listed); '350 Massachusetts' = '350Mass/Better Future Project'. Many not_listed entries look like they came from the MYCC list rather than the MPF page. Events page says 'Check back soon'; no upcoming events found. The Utility Influence Dashboard press event (2026-09-29) is past. [mycc] MYCC has no website of its own; the only published member list found is its Purpose Statement (Google Doc linked from ourclimate.us/state-campaigns/), whose 'Who we are' section names ~30 youth members. Its 'Founding members', 'Additional members' and 'Adult Ally Organizations' sections are blank in the text export (probably images), so adult supporter groups in not_listed (Mothers Out Front, JCAN, MIPL, Climate XChange, etc.) may simply be unreadable rather than dropped. The doc's membership note is dated 9/27/22 and says Sunrise Boston/Western MA/Worcester hubs were inactive and Mass Audubon was not then an official member. Loose matches treated as listed: Salem HS Sustainability Club = Salem HS Environmental Club; Newton South HS Environmental Club ~ Newton South Sustainability Squad; MASSPIRG Amherst/Boston = MASSPIRG Students; MassCOSH Teens Lead at Work ~ MassCOSH Youth Environmental Branch (also listed as new in case they differ); Sunrise hubs = 'Sunrise Movement'. 'Tree Boston' may be the same group as 'Speak for the Trees, Boston' - check before acting. No new public events found; the existing 2026-10-04 call has no public page. MYCC Instagram is @mayouthclimatecoalition (not readable without login). [ejlt] The Table's Action Network group page shows no description, actions or member list. Member comparison uses the Table's own joint comments of April 15, 2021 (hosted on mass.gov), which list 11 member organizations - an old list. No current events/projects/actions found on its own pages. [cccc] Not found: no own website, social page, or MYCC page about the Cross Campus Climate Coalition turned up (searches for the name return only a Timeful scheduling poll titled 'Cross Campus Climate Coalition' and an unrelated Jan 2025 Colleges of the Fenway 'Cross-Campus Climate Mixer'). The MYCC Instagram (@mayouthclimatecoalition) may mention it but requires login. Ask MYCC for a link. [scjc] The site's 'Who we are' page lists 'Organizations that support the No Toxic Biomass campaign' (~55, including SCJC itself); it does not separate SCJC members from campaign supporters, so new_members are campaign supporters. Food & Water Watch's link there points to a staging site, so no website recorded. 'Massachusetts Power and Light' on the page links to massipl.org, recorded as Massachusetts Interfaith Power & Light. Site footer says (c) 2021, but news posts run to July 3, 2026. [gjc] greenjusticecoalition.org now redirects (302) to Community Labor United's page https://www.massclu.org/organizing/green-justice-coalition/ - consider updating the website field. Member comparison uses that page's 'Leadership Team and Our Partners' list (12 organizations; individual names not recorded). No dated events found; newest dated item on the page is from 2024. [crs] Members are the 23 partner logos on the About page (names from logo alt text/link targets; e.g. 'Clean Water Fund - ReThink Disposable', 'Massachusetts Building Electrification Accelerator' (electrifybuildings.org) inferred from logo file names and links). The page also has a map of 40+ district teams (not listed as members). Last announced network meeting was May 26, 2026; no fall 2026 date posted yet. [hero] The coalition now calls itself the AHEAD Coalition (Affordable Housing and Environmental Adaptation Dollars); the bill was originally named HERO. Consider renaming. All 14 current members are on its 'Coalition Members' list. 'Toxics Action Center' on the list is recorded as Community Action Works (its current name); 'Massachusetts Community Action Network' is a different group from the Massachusetts Climate Action Network. The site's Take Action page still points to an old-session HERO bill (S.1799/H.2894) letter tool, so it was not recorded. No dated events or posts newer than 2019 on the site. [vt_environmental_common_agenda] All 22 partners on the 2026 partner list match our members; nothing new or dropped. The agenda is a VCV project with no event calendar of its own; VCV's fall canvass tour (with VPIRG) is VCV's, not the coalition's, so it was not added here. [vt_energy_action_network] Every non-profit on the Members & Partners page is already linked (VECAN, Vermont Clean Communities and VHFA excluded as before); nothing in not_listed. The existing Dec 1 Post-Election Gathering page already is our link; it has pricing (early-bird by Nov 6) but no separate registration link yet, so no event_update. Agenda due early November. [vt_vecan] The VECAN Partners page names five support organizations (VNRC, Vital Communities, EAN, VCRD, Efficiency Vermont); EAN was missing from our members. The town energy committee map is an Atlist embed whose data API requires login, so committees could not be listed. No upcoming events posted; the 2025 conference is the latest in the archive. [vt_actonclimatevt] Member list is the 'Coalition Members' section of the About page (27 organizations; names normalized to the names used elsewhere on our VT map where obvious). The site's platform is labelled 2021 and the newest events are from 2025 (Sun Day, Sept 21, 2025); no upcoming events or current campaigns posted. Possibly winding down - not marked inactive. [vt_t4vt] Members from the logo line on the About page (16 organizations). American Lung Association in Vermont is no longer in it. The Ride Public page also promotes the national Week Without Driving (Oct 1-8, 2026), which T4VT does not host, so it was not added as an event. [vt_clean_communities_coalition] Current Stakeholders page lists ~85 stakeholders, mostly businesses, utilities, towns and agencies; only non-profit/community ones are listed as new_members, following the existing scope. All 7 current members still appear. The /projects/ page shows several projects (Northeast Renewable Diesel Working Group, Energy to Community Stowe EV readiness, EMPOWER workplace charging, Replace Your Ride, Future of Rural Transit, CIISR) but none is dated as current, so none was added. No dated news or events found. [vt_ej_network] No organizational member list is published; the 'About the Team' page lists a steering committee of individuals only (not recorded). Its June 12-13, 2026 EJ Summit is past; no upcoming events posted. Socials: instagram.com/vtej.network.
